Suppose that a certain city is uncooperative and won't set up municipal internet. Comacast is gouging the price because they have no competition. So the residents of that city want to set up their own internet but they don't know how.

This is where you enter the picture. You set up a company which provides fiber installation service. So the customer calls you and ask you to wire them to the internet. You pull up with your van and run some fiber for them and install any equipment the customer might require. You bill for installation and equipment and you are done with that customer. The customer ends up personally owning the piece of infrastructure you installed for them.

So this is like a mesh network but on infrastructure scale. So each of your customers act as a Tier 1 network node just on a smaller scale i.e. they participate in the Internet solely via settlement-free peering.
